# shellcheck disable=SC2016
case "$cmd" in

status)
  load
  if [ -z "$at_head" ]; then at_head=$(fq '$f.built | last | . as $p | $f.packets[$p // ""].head // ""' | jq -r .); fi
  st=$(fq --arg h "$at_head" 'kk_ap_at($f; $policy; $now; $h) + {replacement: kk_ap_required($f)}')
  miss=$(missing_items | paste -sd ' ' - || true)
  if [ "$json" -eq 1 ]; then
    # What a deciding page shows and hands back to decide.
    p=$(jq -r '.packet // ""' <<< "$st")
    facts=null
    if [ -n "$p" ]; then
      ph=$(fq --arg p "$p" '$f.packets[$p].head' | jq -r .)
      pb=$(fq --arg p "$p" '$f.packets[$p].base' | jq -r .)
      pd=$(digest_of "$p" "$ph" "$pb" || true)
      facts=$(fq --arg p "$p" --arg d "$pd" '$f.packets[$p]
        | {head, base, base_ref, expires_at, delivered: (.ready != []), digest: (if $d == "" then null else $d end),
           blocking_feedback: ([.feedback[] | select(.blocking)] | length), expired: ((.expires_at // "") <= $now)}')
    fi
    jq -c --arg t "$ident" --arg pol "$KK_AP_POLICY" --arg h "$at_head" --arg m "$miss" --argjson pf "$facts" \
       --arg rev "$(printf '%s' "$issue" | jq -r '.revision // "" | tostring')" \
      '{ticket: $t, policy: $pol, head: (if $h == "" then null else $h end),
        issue_revision: (if $rev == "" then null else ($rev | tonumber) end)} + .
       + {packet_facts: $pf, projection: {missing: ($m | split(" ") | map(select(. != "")))}}' <<< "$st"
    exit 0
  fi
  echo "$ident — packet approval ($KK_AP_POLICY)"
  if [ "$(jq -r '.packet // ""' <<< "$st")" = "" ]; then
    echo "no packet covers ${at_head:-any revision}"
  else
    p=$(jq -r .packet <<< "$st")
    fq --arg p "$p" '$f.packets[$p] | "packet:   \(.packet)  \(.base[0:12])..\(.head[0:12]) vs \(.base_ref // "?")  expires \(.expires_at // "?")"' | jq -r .
    if [ "$(jq -r '.decision // "" | type' <<< "$st")" = object ]; then say_decision "$(jq -c .decision <<< "$st")"; fi
    if [ "$(jq -r .valid <<< "$st")" = true ]; then
      echo "AUTHORIZED: the decision is valid for ${at_head:0:12}"
    else
      echo "NOT AUTHORIZED at ${at_head:0:12}:"
      jq -r '.reasons[] | "  - \(.text)"' <<< "$st"
    fi
  fi
  [ -z "$miss" ] || echo "projection behind: exposure_grants lacks $miss — run kk-approval reconcile $ticket"
  exit 0
  ;;

audit)
  load
  if [ "$json" -eq 1 ]; then
    fq '$f.decisions | map(del(.i))'
    exit 0
  fi
  echo "$ident — every packet decision, oldest first"
  n=$(fq '$f.decisions | length')
  [ "$n" -gt 0 ] || { echo "  (none recorded)"; exit 0; }
  fq '$f.decisions[]' | while IFS= read -r d; do
    say_decision "$d"
    jq -r '"  recorded \(.recorded_at) by \(.source) · \(.status)"
           + (if (.evidence // {}) != {} then "\n  evidence \(.evidence | tojson)" else "" end)' <<< "$d"
  done
  exit 0
  ;;

decide)
  load
  if record "$packet" "$supersede" "$actor" "$auth" "$(now)" decide '{}' "${actions[@]+"${actions[@]}"}"; then
    rc=0
  else
    rc=$?
  fi
  [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || exit "$rc"
  if [ "$project" -eq 1 ] && ! project; then
    echo "kk-approval: decision $(jq -r .id <<< "$decision") is recorded and counts, but exposure_grants could not be brought up to date. Run: kk-approval reconcile $ticket" >&2
    exit 4
  fi
  if [ "$json" -eq 1 ]; then jq -c 'del(.i)' <<< "$decision"; else say_decision "$decision"; fi
  exit 0
  ;;

reconcile)
  load
  newest=$(fq '$f.built | last' | jq -r '. // ""')
  derived="" why=""
  if [ -n "$newest" ] && [ "$(fq --arg p "$newest" '$f.current[$p] // ""' | jq -r .)" = "" ]; then
    facts=$(fq --arg p "$newest" '$f.packets[$p]')
    head=$(jq -r .head <<< "$facts")
    first_ready=$(jq -r '.ready | first | .at // ""' <<< "$facts")
    held=$(printf '%s\n' "$grants" | tr ',' '\n' | sed -n "s/^\\([a-z-]*\\)@$head\$/\\1/p" \
             | while IFS= read -r a; do case " $CODE_ACTIONS " in *" $a "*) echo "$a" ;; esac; done | sort -u)
    approved=$(jq -c --arg h "$head" '[.approved[] | select(.head == $h)] | last' <<< "$facts")
    if [ "$approved" != null ]; then
      case ",$grants," in
        *",packet=$newest@$head,"*)
          derived=$(jq -c --argjson e "$approved" --arg a "$held" '{at: $e.at, auth: "relay:kk-grant --packet",
              evidence: {history_index: $e.i}, actions: ($a | split("\n") | map(select(. != "")))}' <<< 'null') ;;
        *) why="the approved event for $newest has no matching packet=$newest@$head grant" ;;
      esac
    elif [ -z "$first_ready" ]; then
      why="$newest was never delivered"
    else
      # kk-grant's own audit comment, by a member, after delivery: the grants
      # it names for exactly this head, and still held.
      ev=$(multica issue comment list "$ticket" --output json 2>/dev/null </dev/null \
        | jq -c --arg h "$head" --arg r "$first_ready" --arg x "$(jq -r '.expires_at // ""' <<< "$facts")" --arg held "$held" '
            (if type == "array" then . else (.comments // .items // []) end)
            | [ .[] | select((.author_type // "") == "member" and (.created_at // "")[0:19] > $r[0:19]
                             and (.created_at // "")[0:19] < $x[0:19])
                | ((.content // "" | capture("^Exposure granted by Ethan: `(?<w>[^`]*)`") | .w)? // "") as $w
                | select($w != "")
                | {id, at: .created_at,
                   actions: [$w | split(" ")[] | rtrimstr(",") | select(endswith("@" + $h)) | rtrimstr("@" + $h)
                             | select(. as $a | $held | split("\n") | index($a))]}
                | select(.actions != []) ]
            | sort_by(.at)')
      if [ "$(jq length <<< "$ev")" -eq 0 ]; then
        why="no kk-grant audit comment grants a code action at ${head:0:12} after $newest was delivered"
      else
        last_at=$(jq -r 'last | .at' <<< "$ev")
        # A feedback event after the grant means Ethan said more since.
        if [ "$(jq -r --arg t "$last_at" '[.feedback[] | select(.blocking and (.at // "")[0:19] > $t[0:19])] | length' <<< "$facts")" -gt 0 ]; then
          why="Ethan sent feedback on $newest after the grant"
        else
          derived=$(jq -c '{at: (last | .at), auth: "relay:kk-grant --sha",
              evidence: {comments: map(.id)}, actions: (map(.actions[]) | unique)}' <<< "$ev")
        fi
      fi
    fi
  elif [ -z "$newest" ]; then
    why="$ident has no packet in its history"
  fi

  if [ "$dry" -eq 1 ]; then
    if [ "$json" -eq 1 ]; then
      jq -nc --argjson d "${derived:-null}" --arg why "$why" --arg m "$(missing_items | paste -sd ' ' - || true)" \
        '{would_record: $d, needs_ethan: (if $why == "" then null else $why end),
          projection_missing: ($m | split(" ") | map(select(. != "")))}'
    else
      if [ -n "$derived" ]; then
        jq -r --arg p "$newest" '"would record: \($p), actions \(if (.actions | length) == 0 then "none" else .actions | join(" ") end), decided \(.at) (\(.auth)), evidence \(.evidence | tojson)"' <<< "$derived"
      fi
      [ -z "$why" ] || echo "needs Ethan: $why"
      m=$(missing_items | paste -sd ' ' - || true)
      [ -z "$m" ] || echo "would add to exposure_grants: $m"
    fi
    exit 0
  fi

  if [ -n "$derived" ]; then
    mapfile -t dacts < <(jq -r '.actions[]' <<< "$derived")
    if record "$newest" "" ethan "$(jq -r .auth <<< "$derived")" "$(jq -r .at <<< "$derived")" reconcile \
         "$(jq -c .evidence <<< "$derived")" "${dacts[@]+"${dacts[@]}"}"; then
      rc=0
    else
      rc=$?
    fi
    [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || exit "$rc"
    echo "recorded from audit evidence:" >&2
    say_decision "$decision" >&2
  fi
  project || { echo "kk-approval: exposure_grants could not be brought up to date on $ident; rerun." >&2; exit 4; }
  if [ "$json" -eq 1 ]; then
    jq -nc --argjson d "${decision:-null}" --arg why "$why" '{recorded: ($d | if . then del(.i) else . end),
      needs_ethan: (if $why == "" then null else $why end)}'
  else
    [ -z "$why" ] || echo "needs Ethan: $why. Nothing was derived; he decides again with kk-grant <id> --packet <id>."
    echo "reconciled $ident"
  fi
  [ -z "$why" ] || exit 6
  exit 0
  ;;

esac

# kk-packet-approval (PER-78). Run as openclaw by the review-feedback service,
# for the approval controls on a packet's page:
#
#   kk-packet-approval status <packet-id>
#   kk-packet-approval decide <packet-id> <none|push|pr> <actor> <device>
#                      <digest> <head> <base> <policy> <revision|-> <feedback-seen> <supersede|->
#   kk-packet-approval dispatch <packet-id>
#
# The ticket comes from the route kk-packet recorded. The only grants it can
# make are push, and pr with push; never force-push, review-request or merge.
# status adds kk-dispatch's status as `publication`; dispatch hands a pending
# Gatekeeper job over (PER-83), after arming a kk-watch in the packet's session
# (PER-95). KKPA_* are prepended by modules/kingkong-manager.nix.
#
# Exit: kk-approval's or kk-dispatch's (0, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8), 12 when refused here,
# or 14 when no watch could be armed and so nothing was dispatched.

export HOME=$KKPA_HOME
export PATH=$KKPA_PATH
unset XDG_STATE_HOME

changes.beforeContent:
cmd=${1:-}
pid=${2:-}
case "$cmd:$#" in
  status:2|dispatch:2|decide:12) ;;
  *) fail "usage: kk-packet-approval status <packet-id> | dispatch <packet-id> | decide <packet-id> <none|push|pr> <actor> <device> <digest> <head> <base> <policy> <revision|-> <feedback-seen> <supersede|->" ;;
esac
printf '%s' "$pid" | grep -qE '^p-[0-9]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4,64}$' || fail "'$pid' is not a packet id"

route="$KKPA_STATE/packets/$pid.json"
[ -f "$route" ] || fail "no route recorded for $pid — it was not finished by kk-packet"
ticket=$(jq -r '.ticket // empty' "$route")
workspace=$(jq -r '.workspace // empty' "$route")
[ -n "$ticket" ] || fail "the route for $pid names no ticket"
ws=()
[ -z "$workspace" ] || ws=(--workspace "$workspace")

if [ "$cmd" = status ]; then
  approval=$(kk-approval status "$ticket" --output json "${ws[@]+"${ws[@]}"}") || exit $?
  pub=$(kk-dispatch status "$ticket" --output json "${ws[@]+"${ws[@]}"}" 2>/dev/null) || pub=null
  jq -e 'type == "object"' <<< "$pub" >/dev/null 2>&1 || pub=null
  jq -c --argjson p "$pub" '. + {publication: $p}' <<< "$approval"
  exit 0
fi
if [ "$cmd" = dispatch ]; then
  # PER-95: a pending attempt gets a watch in the packet's session before the
  # hand-over can start a run, once per attempt (the mark), and none if it cannot.
  pub=$(kk-dispatch status "$ticket" --output json "${ws[@]+"${ws[@]}"}") || exit $?
  job=$(jq -r 'if .state == "pending" then "\(.job.job)-\(.job.attempt)" else empty end' <<< "$pub")
  mark="$KKPA_STATE/watches/$ticket/$job"
  if [ -n "$job" ] && [ ! -f "$mark" ]; then
    key=$(jq -r '.session_key // empty' "$route")
    printf '%s' "$key" | grep -qE '^agent:[^:]+:[^:]+:' \
      || { echo "kk-packet-approval: the route for $pid holds no session key; nothing was handed to Gatekeeper" >&2; exit 14; }
    if ! out=$(kk-watch add "$ticket" --force --session-key "$key" "${ws[@]+"${ws[@]}"}" 2>&1 </dev/null); then
      echo "kk-packet-approval: the completion watch could not be armed, so nothing was handed to Gatekeeper: $(printf '%s' "$out" | tail -2 | tr '\n' ' ')" >&2
      exit 14
    fi
    mkdir -p "$(dirname "$mark")"
    jq -nc --arg k "$key" --arg at "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" '{session_key: $k, at: $at}' > "$mark.tmp"
    mv "$mark.tmp" "$mark"
  fi
  rc=0
  kk-dispatch dispatch "$ticket" --output json "${ws[@]+"${ws[@]}"}" || rc=$?
  # Proven undelivered: no run will start, so the watch would only expire.
  if [ "$rc" = 4 ] && [ -f "$mark" ] && kk-dispatch status "$ticket" --output json "${ws[@]+"${ws[@]}"}" 2>/dev/null \
       | jq -e --arg j "$job" '"\(.job.job)-\(.job.attempt)" == $j and .job.last.state == "undelivered"' >/dev/null; then
    kk-watch cancel "$ticket" "${ws[@]+"${ws[@]}"}" >/dev/null 2>&1 </dev/null || true
    rm -f "$mark"
  fi
  exit "$rc"
fi

delivery=$3 actor=$4 device=$5 digest=$6 head=$7 base=$8 policy=$9 revision=${10} seen=${11} supersede=${12}
case "$delivery" in
  none) actions=() ;;
  push) actions=(--action push) ;;
  pr) actions=(--action push --action pr) ;;
  *) fail "'$delivery' is not a delivery choice: none, push or pr" ;;
esac
printf '%s' "$device" | grep -qE '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,62}$' || fail "'$device' is not a device name"
printf '%s' "$digest" | grep -qE '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' || fail "'$digest' is not a packet digest"

# kk-approval — the canonical record of Ethan's packet approvals (PER-77). Not
# a command; prepended by modules/kingkong-manager.nix to every script that
# reads or writes one. See references/packet-approval.md.
#
# An approval is a `decision` event in review_packet_history. Everything that
# asks "did Ethan approve this code?" folds the history with KK_AP_JQ and asks
# the decision, never review_packet_state, packet_review_required or the
# packet= entries in exposure_grants: those are projections of it.

# Bumped when the rules a decision is judged by change. A decision made under
# another version is not valid: Ethan decides again.

def kk_ap_code_actions: ["force-push", "pr", "push", "review-request"];

# What the artifact digest is taken over: the packet facts and the narrative
# Ethan read, as packet.json records their own digests.
def kk_ap_preimage: (."facts/digest" // "") + "\n" + (."narrative/digest" // "");

# The fields a decision is identified by. Same fields, same key: a replay.
# lease, the remote head a force-push may replace, only when there is one, so
# keys recorded before it existed still match.
def kk_ap_identity:
  {ticket, packet, digest, head, base, actions: (.actions | unique), policy, supersedes}
  + (if .lease then {lease} else {} end);

# What one logical packet build is identified by (PER-79). Same fields, same
# build: a retry or a second trigger resumes it rather than starting another.
def kk_ap_build_identity: {ticket, head, base, predecessor, policy};

# The history, folded. Each packet: where it was built, when it was delivered
# (ready) and with what digest, and the feedback sent on it; every feedback
# event again, in order, across packets. Each decision
# carries its index and a status: effective (the current one for its packet),
# superseded, duplicate (a replay), or conflict (it named a predecessor that
# was not current when it landed; it never counts).

  | reduce .[] as $x ({packets: {}, built: [], decisions: [], current: {}, feedback: []};
      $x.key as $i | $x.value as $e
      | if $e.event == "built" then
          .built += [$e.packet]
          | .packets[$e.packet] = {packet: $e.packet, ticket: $e.ticket, head: $e.head, base: $e.base,

          .packets[$e.packet].ready += [{i: $i, at: $e.at, digest: ($e.digest // null)}]
